videos.title: How to create a Web Component using Vanilla JS
videos.description: This video demonstrates building a Web Component with Vanilla JS, exploring Shadow DOM, lifecycle events, and attribute/property synchronization. It details challenges in rendering UI with innerHTML and managing event handling, providing insights into core Web Component concepts…

videos.title: How to build your first Lit component
videos.description: Learn how to build your first custom HTML tag using Lit, a simple library for creating fast, lightweight web components. This tutorial guides you through creating a 'word-viewer' component from scratch, covering essential Lit concepts like LitElement, reactive properties, state…

videos.title: Make Web Components great with Lit
videos.description: This video introduces Lit, exploring the Web Components standard and its integration with JavaScript. It covers the benefits of Lit and demonstrates how to create web components using the library.

videos.title: How to build a carousel in Lit
videos.description: This video details building a carousel with Lit, demonstrating how to pass child DOM into web components and compose them. It covers using the Web Animation API, SVGs, styles, and events, concluding with integration of the custom element into a Create React App.
